reviews.text: I had my car detailed by E&J great people and my car looks like it did when I first bought it in 2020. Elija I am happy how well you and Jerr took care of my car. I only go to the one place for my car but this is my new place to get my car washed and detailed. I am very happy and I like to bring my business to neighbourhood people. Keep up the great work.
reviews.author: Dawn Paris

reviews.text: My BMW was pretty filthy after traveling with my dog on a trip, and I don’t trust just anyone with my car. E&J got me right in with an appointment and did an amazing job cleaning the interior and exterior, and conditioning the leather. I 100% recommend them if you need your car detailed.
reviews.author: Brandon Baker

reviews.text: Probably the best car detailing place around. For one they come to you ! For two when my car was finished with them it was so clean and smelled so good. I was very impressed.
reviews.author: Juliana Hujack

reviews.text: Great job.  Thank you.  Raptor R looks R-eally clean!
reviews.author: Dan Heller

reviews.text: My car was an absolute disaster having 3 children, took it to e&j and wow. my car absolutely SPOTLESS. The owner was so sweet and polite. My car smelled amazing, looked brand new. Will DEFINITELY return
reviews.author: Sabrina Lynn
